about: Saint-Apollinaire is a municipality in Lotbinière, Quebec, on the Highway 20 corridor southwest of Québec City—not a borough of the capital. A growing residential and service community among south-shore farms, it sits between the St. Lawrence lowlands and the Appalachian approach. About 8,000 people live in Saint-Apollinaire.
